title: Web: Home steps
description: The `steps` part of web_home: the day's steps (MFP's steps minus run steps) against the step goal. Under steps.not_tracked_below raw steps (or none) the day isn't tracked: steps, to_go and kcal are null. kcal is the step part of the day's target, k x (steps - goal) (negative = below the goal), under the targets valid that day; null without a step model (before a phase or its start). provisional: today, so steps and kcal still move until the day ends.

to_go.description: Steps still to reach the goal, 0 once reached.

run_steps_removed.description: Steps of runs and reported sessions with a distance, left out so the session counts once.
